title: Stage 20 randomized evidence-challenge, audit-yield, and tamper-detection board
hypothesis: A synthetic board can show whether a precommitted random challenge sample would expose missing or altered evidence more reliably than convenience review while refusing to convert a clean sample into readiness or exhaustive-security assurance.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate seed provenance, sample frame, selection timing, missing-item treatment, tamper flags, clean-sample interpretation, exact gates, and reviewer independence; biased or overpromoted boards must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural, proxy, open-gap, or exact-gate software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the frozen software evidence class and cannot promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
